sentence: This project builds robots that learn to interpret a dog's posture, movement, and vocalizations and respond to those cues.
This project builds a way to screen many polymer materials at once, using DNA staples to join polymer blocks together.
This project builds ground-penetrating radar tools that use AI to make real-time, high-resolution images of what lies beneath the surface.
This project develops algorithms that make reliable decisions even when the machine learning predictions they use are unreliable.
This project studies how losing animals from tropical forests changes the causes of seed and seedling mortality.
This project studies how swelling polyethylene with fatty acids or other amphiphiles controls the porosity and nanostructure of the material.
This project uses molecular dynamics simulations to study DNA structures that combine left-handed and right-handed forms.
This project tests whether thermodynamics can predict which mutated genes give resistance to antibiotics.
This project uses deep learning models and numerical simulations of supercell thunderstorms to find out how tornadoes form.
This project builds deep learning models to study how signaling and red blood cell stiffness affect the engulfment of red blood cells by macrophages.
This project studies how plants and animals on land were affected by an ancient event of rapid and extreme warming.
This project develops ways to see finer detail in optical images by combining physical models of imaging with artificial intelligence.
This project studies whether an infinite set of points in space can be described by a small number of variables.
This project works on computational mathematics, machine learning, statistical modeling, and pattern formation.
This project builds a cybersecurity curriculum with four certificate programs.
